mapper.select: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN overtime_type = 'WORKDAY' THEN duration ELSE 0 END) AS workdayHours, SUM(CASE WHEN overtime_type = 'WEEKEND' THEN duration ELSE 0 END) AS weekendHours, SUM(CASE WHEN overtime_type = 'HOLIDAY' THEN duration ELSE 0 END) AS holidayHours, SUM(duration) AS totalHours, SUM(CASE WHEN compensation_type = 'TIME_OFF' THEN COALESCE(quota_amount, compensation_hours / 8, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS timeOffHours, COUNT(*) AS overtimeCount FROM hr_overtime_application WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND status = 'APPROVED' AND YEAR(start_time) = #{year} AND MONTH(start_time) = #{month} AND deleted = 0
